title: mkDashRamp: bound dash LENGTH below MK_BAND_ONSET_D so dashes read as discrete marks riding the rulings, not broken rulings (T3b-review.md condition 3 follow-up)
finding: T3b-review.md condition 3: at d<=MK_BAND_ONSET_D each single-pass (or band) mark can still occupy its OWN ENTIRE PERIOD (each===sv.P, 'L=P is an unbroken ruling' per layMark's own dissolution-ramp comment), so consecutive dashes ABUT with no gap. T4's own duty-cycle mechanism (mkAsk/g/period) governs this and is UNCHANGED pre/post T3b -- STILL-OPEN.md's W-06b row (user-reports/10.png): 'discrete dashes riding rulings at every density, never row-wide tiles'.
acceptance_bar: in the onset-ramp region (bandOnsetCap(density) < MK_BAND_MAX_PASSES, measured d<32 on every {sphere,torus}x{addLayer,create} combo) a dash's own drawn along-row length must be measurably bounded (this unit's public proxy: average dark-third mark length, lastMarkStats.lenByThird[2]/cntByThird[2], must drop to <=70% of the pre-fix value); T3's own dash-COUNT bar (>=40 @ d=1, non-decreasing d=1..50) and T3b's O10 (bandMax===1, pens===marks, d=1..4) must survive UNCHANGED; T4/T3b's own territory (d>=MK_BAND_ONSET_D, i.e. d=35/50/220) must stay byte-identical (md5).

rejected_design_scaling_capOf_upstream.note: First design tried: scale the BAND cap (capOf(per) = bandN*per*X) in solveAt. REJECTED with measurement -- shrinking L this way also shrinks nn (Math.ceil(sv.L/sv.P)), and nn (stacked-pass count) is the ONLY thing keeping tot (place()'s own MIN_MARK_MM survival gate, summed across all nn passes) above the floor at this fixture's many foreshortened, small-local-P samples.
rejected_design_scaling_capOf_upstream.conclusion: d=1 dropped 46->34 (12 marks lost via MIN_MARK_MM), d=5 46->41, d=10 62->48, d=25 63->48 -- a bar change to a file this unit is FORBIDDEN to edit (scene3d-mkdashramp-single-pass.test.js). Diagnosed: died marks all had nn:1 (collapsed from their true bandN via the shared L/nn coupling), P as low as 0.37-3.23mm, each after the 0.5x cut as low as 0.139mm (<< MIN_MARK_MM=0.6mm).

shipped_design: surface-fill.js, layMark's law.shape==='morph' branch only. nn/bandN/n0 computed EXACTLY as T3b left them (untouched). AFTER nn is fixed, each pass's own along-row length is separately bounded: eachDrawn = (bandOnsetCap(density) < MK_BAND_MAX_PASSES && each > floor && each > target) ? min(each, max(floor, target)) : each, where target = MK_DASH_LEN_FRAC(0.5) * sv.P and floor = MIN_MARK_MM * 1.05. The floor clause means a mark that would only clear MIN_MARK_MM via a LONGER pass is left at its own original (uncut) length instead of being pushed under the floor -- this is what makes place()'s accept/reject outcome, and therefore mark COUNT, provably unchanged from T3b's tree.

gate_choice_bandOnsetCap_not_bandN.note: Gating on the packing-limited `bandN` itself (not bandOnsetCap's own raw output) was tried and REJECTED: bandN also falls below MK_BAND_MAX_PASSES at HIGH density (~d>=50, the 0.90*bandPitch/w packing floor) for a reason unrelated to the onset ramp, and gating on it leaked the new cap into that untouchable territory, corrupting md5 byte-identity at d=50/d=220.

non_regression_d35_d50_d220.note: md5 of generate()'s own path output, current vs pre-T3c mutant, sphere AND torus, both rigs -- all byte-identical

evidence.before_source: scratch git-archive export of this unit's own base sha (75777240), captured with the SAME rig/cell/camera as the after shot -- NOT the top-level gallery baseline (which still reflects a PRE-T3/T3b state, since T3/T3b/T3c have none of them merged to main yet and would misattribute T3+T3b's own contribution to this unit).
evidence.what_i_saw: sphere/torus, low density, BOTH rigs: BEFORE each row reads as one long, mostly-continuous curving stroke broken only by occasional small nicks -- a broken ruling. AFTER the SAME rows read unambiguously as a series of short, clearly-separated discrete dash segments with real gaps between them -- a sparse texture of discrete marks riding the ruling, exactly Jay's stated goal. med/max density, both rigs: pixel-identical to the before state (confirmed both visually and by md5) -- T4's dark-end band mechanism is untouched.
